title: Baseline-to-recovery structural comparison
summary: Early-to-mid record comparisons establish baseline variability in stem structure and composition after initial mapping and recensus alignment.
uncertainty: Interpretation is constrained by interval timing and potential unmeasured disturbance effects.

title: Functional composition reorganization
summary: Mid-series census contrasts indicate directional changes in functional composition and diversity under changing climatic and successional context.
uncertainty: Directional shifts are observational and may reflect interacting drivers rather than a single mechanism.

title: Recent drought-era canopy response
summary: Recent observations are consistent with stronger chronic and episodic drought signatures and altered phenology in parts of the landscape.
uncertainty: Covariation between drought metrics and biological responses does not alone establish causation.

title: Long-record resilience and sensitivity
summary: Across the full monitoring record, the plot shows both sensitivity in composition and resilience in some productivity indicators.
uncertainty: Inferences are strongest for this site and should be generalized beyond San Emilio with caution.
source: ForestGEO + Enquist and Enquist 2011 + Swenson et al. 2020 + Huang et al. 2021
